```{r load-rxx}
mod_stats <- read_rds(here(pilots_dir, "02_scoring_outputs/mod_stats.rds"))

task_rxx <- mod_stats |>
  rename(item_task = task) |>
  left_join(task_mods) |>
  # filter(item_task %in% core_tasks) |>
  mutate(task_rxx = if_else(model_set == "by_language", lang_rxx, scalar_rxx)) |>
  select(item_task, task_model_set = model_set, task_itemtype = itemtype,
         task_invariance = invariance, task_rxx) |>
  unnest(task_rxx) |>
  mutate(task_invariance = if_else(task_invariance == "", "configural", task_invariance),
         invariance = if_else(invariance == "", "configural", invariance)) |>
  filter(model_set == task_model_set, task_itemtype == itemtype,
         task_invariance == invariance) |>
  mutate(
    group_label = if_else(is.na(group), subset, group |> fct_recode(!!!site_labels)),
    itemtype = itemtype |> fct_recode("Rasch" = "rasch", "2PL" = "2pl"),
    invariance = invariance |> str_to_sentence()
  ) |>
  left_join(task_info) |>
  select(task, itemtype, invariance, group_label, empirical_rxx) |>
  arrange(task) |>
  mutate(across(c(task, itemtype, invariance),
                \(s) if_else(task == lag(task) & !is.na(lag(task)), "", s)))

mod_subgroup_stats <- read_rds(here(pilots_dir, "02_scoring_outputs/mod_subgroup_stats.rds"))
subgroup_rxx <- mod_subgroup_stats |>
  # filter(model_type == "singlegroup") |>
  # filter(group_var == "age_group") |>
  select(item_task = task, itemtype, invariance, group_var, rxx) |>
  unnest(rxx) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(group_var, group), values_from = empirical_rxx,
              names_sep = "-") |>
  left_join(task_info) |>
  arrange(task) |>
  select(task, itemtype, invariance, where(is.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    itemtype = itemtype |> fct_recode("Rasch" = "rasch", "2PL" = "2pl"),
    invariance = invariance |> str_to_sentence()
  )
```
